events.verdict: Young (IND) sets the pick on VanVleet (TOR) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Collison (IND) keeps his hand on the side of the ball as he enters the perimeter and legally continues his dribble thereafter.
Ibaka (TOR) sets the pick on Joseph (IND) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Joseph (IND) makes "high-five" contact with VanVleet (TOR) after the release of his jump shot attempt.
Turner (IND) briefly grasps Ibaka's (TOR) shorts as the shot is released, but releases without affecting his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Young (IND) firms up during the pick and makes marginal contact with VanVleet (TOR), but doesn't affect his ability to maintain defensive position.
[Observable in enhanced video] Siakam (TOR) is in the lane for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Lowry (TOR) makes legal hand-on-ball contact with Turner (IND) during rebounding.
Ibaka (TOR) sets the pick on Joseph (IND) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] RLB shows Turner (IND) lifts and re-plants his pivot foot to the floor at the start of his dribble.

Siakam (TOR) is drawn into the air on the pump fake and makes body contact with Turner (IND) as he returns to the floor. The contact occurs prior to Turner's upward shooting motion and the play is correctly deemed a personal foul.
Evans (IND) briefly places his arm around Siakam's (TOR) midsection before correcting.
Young (IND) hedges the pick and makes marginal body contact with Lowry (TOR) that does not affect his SQBR.

Ibaka (TOR) makes slight contact with Turner's (IND) head during rebounding. Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
VanVleet (TOR) engages and disengages with Evans (IND) without affecting his FOM during the inbound.
[Observable in enhanced video] Collison (IND) lifts and re-plants his pivot foot to the floor at the start of his dribble.
Green (TOR) makes marginal lower body contact with Collison (IND) as he starts his dribble.
Green (TOR) reflexively places his arms around Young's (IND) midsection as the pick is set and makes contact that is tactile in nature.
[Observable in enhanced video] Turner (IND) is in the lane for longer than three seconds.
Lowry (TOR) makes marginal body contact with Young (IND) during his driving shot attempt.
Ibaka (TOR) does not fully establish himself in Bogdanovic's (IND) defensive path prior to contact being made, but it is marginal in nature and does not affect his ability to defend.
Lowry (TOR) commits the take foul on Evans (IND) in the corner.
Lowry (TOR) commits the take foul on Collison (IND) after the inbound.
